limitations: This is an estimate, not provider xG.
Provider xG uses shot locations and a provider model; this record has no shot coordinates.
The estimate is fit on 2026-27 league team rows only; applying it to earlier seasons assumes a stable relationship.
This is a separate estimate for rows without provider xG; it is not the fxg-3 calibration gate.
